A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 38-page versions of the same research work, including Appendices A–M. Full-text comparison and rendered-page checks support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v7 reports original Atari and continuous-control experiments in Section 6, with further empirical comparisons and ablations in Appendices G.2 and L.

after.justification: v8 retains the original experimental results in Section 6 and Appendices G.2 and L, including learning curves and regularization ablations.

M1.justification: The return-density decomposition, regularized objectives, actor-critic procedure, and quantile-loss extension are unchanged in Sections 4–7 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same Atari games and continuous-control environments, including all appendix experiments. No task, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The DQN/C51 comparisons, decomposed variants, and AC, SAC, DAC, and DSAC comparator sets remain unchanged within their corresponding experiments, including appendix comparisons.

E3.justification: Section 6, Appendix K, and Table 1 retain the same evaluation metrics, training budgets, model configurations, hyperparameters, and experimental procedures.

E4.justification: The regularization-strength ablations, entropy-interaction experiments, cross-entropy versus KL comparison, and atom-count sensitivity analysis are unchanged (Section 6; Appendices G.2 and L).

E5.justification: Seed counts and uncertainty reporting are identical, including three seeds and standard-deviation shading in Figure 3 and five seeds in Figure 4. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: The learning curves in Figures 3–8 and their accompanying numerical and qualitative findings are unchanged. No result entries, rankings, or reported trends are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, propositions, theorems, and proofs are unchanged, including decomposition validity, the Neural FQI/FZI connection, DERPI convergence, and the appendix quantile-loss analysis.

C1.justification: The abstract, numbered contributions, and conclusion retain the same scientific meaning and scope. Removing an unfinished empty-citation clause from the introduction does not alter the stated contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations of uncertainty-aware exploration and regularizer improvement/interference remain unchanged, as do the limitations concerning general distributional RL and varying learned distributions (Section 8; Appendices J.4 and L).

D1.justification: Appendix K and Table 1 provide identical implementation information. The GPU disclosure and stated plan to release code are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are retained. References [19] and [35] receive bibliographic metadata or capitalization edits only; the deleted empty citation identifies no work.

P1.justification: v8 removes 'providing consitent evidence for []' from the introduction, adds volume and page information to reference [19], standardizes venue capitalization in [19] and [35], and updates the arXiv version/date markings. These are localized editorial edits.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8, Table 1, Algorithm 1, their captions, and their placement are unchanged. The editorial corrections only rewrap local text within the existing page layout.

improvement.justification: Removing the unfinished empty-citation clause improves the introduction's polish, and completing reference [19] improves bibliographic completeness. This is a limited editorial gain; the methods, theoretical support, empirical evidence, and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
